key.name: tab-w
key.description: Width of window tabs in logical pixels; updates the compositor live.

key.name: tab-h
key.description: Height before interface scaling; updates the compositor and top bar live.

key.name: grid-step
key.description: Space between background grid lines; updates live.

key.name: bg
key.description: Six hex digits. Applies to compositor, settings and top bar.

key.name: grid
key.description: Six hex digits. Applies to compositor grid lines.

key.name: tabbar
key.description: Six hex digits. Applies to compositor, settings and top bar.

key.name: border
key.description: Six hex digits. Strong contrast overrides the visible border.

key.name: unfocused
key.description: Six hex digits. Strong contrast overrides this colour.

key.name: terminal
key.description: Shell command launched by Alt+Enter. Maximum 127 bytes.

key.name: launcher
key.description: Shell command launched by Alt+D. Maximum 127 bytes.

key.name: browser-cmd
key.description: Shell command launched by Alt+W.

key.name: settings-cmd
key.description: Shell command launched by Alt+S.

key.name: help-cmd
key.description: Shell command launched by Alt+F1.

key.name: chat-cmd
key.description: Shell command for the native chat window.

key.name: chat-app-id
key.description: Wayland application ID used to locate the native chat window.

key.name: scripts-cmd
key.description: Shell command for the scripts window.

key.name: scripts-app-id
key.description: Wayland application ID used to locate the scripts window.

key.name: xkb-model
key.description: XKB model. An empty value uses the platform default.

key.name: xkb-layout
key.description: XKB layout or comma-separated layouts; changes connected keyboards live.

key.name: xkb-variant
key.description: XKB variant corresponding to the selected layout.

key.name: xkb-options
key.description: Comma-separated XKB options; changes connected keyboards live.

key.name: repeat-rate
key.description: Repeated keys per second. Zero disables repeat.

key.name: repeat-delay
key.description: Milliseconds before a held key starts repeating.

key.name: privacy-hide-titles
key.description: Show application names in the compositor tab bar.

key.name: privacy-hide-network
key.description: Conceal network names in the top bar and quick settings.

key.name: privacy-remember-layout
key.description: Save and restore window positions. Disabling removes the saved native layout.

key.name: privacy-save-titles
key.description: Allow window titles in saved layout records; disabling scrubs stored titles.

key.name: privacy-clipboard
key.description: Allow applications to share the Wayland clipboard. Disabling clears it.

key.name: privacy-clear-clipboard-on-lock
key.description: Drop the Wayland selection after the graphical session locks.

key.name: privacy-lock-minutes
key.description: Idle minutes before swaylock starts. Zero disables automatic locking.

key.name: pointer-speed
key.description: Libinput acceleration speed from -100 (slow) to 100 (fast). Requires a capable pointer.

key.name: natural-scroll
key.description: Reverse scrolling on supported libinput pointing devices.

key.name: left-handed
key.description: Swap primary buttons on supported libinput pointing devices.

key.name: tap-to-click
key.description: Enable tapping on libinput touchpads with tap support.

key.name: disable-while-typing
key.description: Suppress accidental touchpad motion during typing on supported devices.

key.name: clock-format
key.description: Use 24-hour or 12-hour time in the live top bar.

key.name: clock-seconds
key.description: Include seconds in the live top bar clock.
